description: This file defines the custom runtime exception 'GLClosureInvalidDeleteException', used to signal invalid delete actions on GL closures within the accounting module of the project.

classes.name: GLClosureInvalidDeleteException
classes.description: A custom exception extending AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException, thrown when an attempt to delete a GL closure is invalid due to existing closures.

methods.name: GLClosureInvalidDeleteException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with details about the office and closure date, constructing an error message.

calls: super(String messageCode, String defaultMessage, Object... args)
